ABOUT THIS GAME

MALAM: School is an immersive, first-person interactive horror experience rooted in the eerie urban legends of Malaysian high schools. Built on a foundation of environmental storytelling, the game challenges you to navigate a familiar school space where reality and memory blur into a humid, quiet dread.

To survive the night, you must sharpen your senses. Listen to the shifting environment. Every creak and whisper has been meticulously crafted to recreate the authentic, heavy atmosphere of a Malaysian independent school.

CORE MECHANICS

Dynamic Investigation: The game features a "Zoom-in" mechanic. Players must carefully observe the environment to trigger events. There is no traditional UI—only your intuition and the unsettling changes in your surroundings.

A Different Kind of Dread: There are no chase sequences or sprint buttons. The horror is psychological and slow-paced, forcing you to confront uncanny visual distortions and a lingering sense of being watched.

Four Direction Observation: Use a dedicated mechanic to look beyond the primary frame. Switch perspectives to inspect hidden details in the environment—clues that only manifest when viewed from specific, deliberate angles.

Authentic Soundscapes: Immerse yourself in the distinct ambient sounds of Malaysia. From the low hum of old fans to the oppressive silence of a tropical night, the audio is a key component of the investigation.

Unfolding Events

The school changes as events progress. Familiar rooms may appear slightly different when revisited, with new sounds, altered objects, opened doors, or unexpected figures appearing where nothing was before.

Progress comes from observing these changes, investigating points of interest, and gradually connecting fragments of the school's past.

THE NATURE OF NANYANG HORROR

The anomalies here are not about physical violence; they are about spiritual deprivation and local taboos. It explores a uniquely South-East Asian fear: the concept of the cycle of unresolved karma. By the time you close the game, you may find that the reality you return to feels just as haunted.

A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPER (AI & DREAMS)

MALAM: School is a project born from a lifelong dream and the power of modern technology. As an independent artist without a traditional background in game development, I have utilized AI extensively to bring this vision to life.

Without these AI tools, a project this personal and complete would have remained an unachievable dream for an outsider like me. Every visual distortion and synthesized soundscape is a result of a dialogue between human folklore and machine intelligence. This is not just a game; it is a testament to how technology can empower an individual to tell their story.

I invite you to experience this experiment—a journey into the "Uncanny Valley" created by a dreamer who dared to create with the help of AI. Selamat MALAM.

MAKE PIZZA. HOLD THE LINE. PURIFY THE UNDEAD.

Hungry zombies are crowding the counter, and surviving the dinner rush takes two very different roles.

The Chef reads each order, chooses the right ingredients, bakes the pizza, and prepares it for delivery. At the same time, the Hunter selects targets, attacks, blocks, and keeps neutralized zombies under control.

TEAMWORK IS THE SECRET INGREDIENT

A pizza can be delivered only when it is ready, the correct target has been subdued, and the order matches. Coordinate the kitchen and the battlefield, then throw the pizza at exactly the right moment. Serve the wrong order and the customer storms off. Take too long and even a perfect pizza goes stale.

KNOW WHAT EACH ZOMBIE HATES

Every zombie shows the one ingredient it can't stand. If it appears in the recipe, leave every bit of it out. Learn each zombie's tastes and tricks, then turn that knowledge into faster, cleaner service.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Take on the rush in single-player, or split the responsibilities in local shared-screen co-op: one player handles the keyboard as the Chef while the other fights with the mouse as the Hunter.

Cook fast. Fight smart. Throw the right pizza.

MARSTEAD is a colony sim about building a settlement on Mars with the survivors of a crashed transport ship. Start with three colonists and three escape pods, establish the essentials and assign work to suit their skills. Grow crops, manufacture equipment, trade with visitors and prepare for hostile raids.

A demo covering your first 10 sols


The demo covers your colony's first 10 sols (Martian days), with saving, loading and the option to start again. Establish shelter, life support and food production, and work toward radio contact. The full game continues beyond this limit into the research and long-term projects described below.

Pressurized rooms and reliable power


Build enclosed rooms with walls, doors and airlocks, then supply them with oxygen. Water supports drinking, oxygen production, farming and cooking. Start a power grid with solar panels and batteries, and expand generation as the settlement grows. Keep reserves for cold snaps and dust storms, and send colonists to repair leaks and broken equipment before essential services come to a halt.

From growing beds to the kitchen


Plant rice, wheat and potatoes, and assign colonists to sow, water and harvest. Set up a kitchen to turn crops into porridge, rice, bread, baked potatoes and stew. Order just enough meals or maintain a target stock. Watch your remaining food and the next harvest before expanding the colony. You can also grow medicinal herbs to supply future medicine production.

Work, relationships and medical care


Each colonist has a profession, traits and skills. Set individual priorities for construction, mining, farming, cooking and research, and watch their skills improve through work. Friendships, romances and rivalries develop as people live together, affecting their moods. Illness and injuries require rest, medical beds and someone to provide care. Manufacture medicine for treatment, or help an injured visitor recover before they leave.

Mining, storage and manufacturing


Mined resources and harvested crops remain on the ground until colonists carry them to storage or a workplace. Place shelves and storage zones, and leave routes to construction sites and production facilities. Smelt and process materials into parts and equipment, then research precision manufacturing. Set production quantities and stock targets; orders proceed when materials, power and a worker are available.

Radio contact and visiting traders


Power a radio transmitter to contact Earth and prepare for supply ships. Meet traders, government troops, deserters and other factions; trade and your responses to them affect your relationships. Alien visitors belong to five species, each with different specialties and preferred purchases. Sell surplus resources to buy food, medicine, parts or new equipment, taking account of what each trader has in stock.

Armed colonists and base defenses


Equip colonists with weapons and place turrets to defend against escaped convicts and hostile factions. Watch firing ranges, obstacles and friendly positions, and treat the wounded afterward. Further research unlocks security robots that need charging and repairs, and mortars that need ammunition and an operator. You can also take incapacitated human enemies into custody and work toward recruiting them through conversation. Later in the full game, you can build missile launchers and supply them with power and ammunition to strike hostile faction bases.

Research, suit modules and rovers


Research life support, industry, power, defense, suits, planetary environment and space technology. Make suit modules for different jobs and unlock new facilities. Later in the full game, scanners locate buried ruins and mining rovers work at assigned deposits or discovered sites. Rovers return to their docks with the cargo. Use recovered ancient documents to support research, or sell treasures to traders.

Long-term projects in the full game


Gather materials for advanced research and large construction projects while keeping the colony supplied. Terraforming facilities improve atmospheric, temperature, oxygen, water and biomass conditions. You can also prepare a return to Earth or a journey to another planet. Each project requires materials and operating facilities across several stages. Complete the preparations, then choose when to take the final step and end your settlement's journey.

  • Three difficulty settings: Calm, Standard and Harsh

IT grows. You run.

The tag you played as a kid, with one twist: whoever is IT GROWS every second. Normal size at the start of a round — a doorway-blocking giant by the end.

That's both your danger and your escape. A giant IT can't fit through tunnels and narrow doors, and you learn to use that. But when the round ends the biggest player is eliminated, so IT is in a hurry too.

The slap

Hold left click to charge. Release in the RED zone and it's a SHAAAP — your target is stunned and sent flying. You can slap without being IT, too: shoving a friend into the tagger's arms is entirely legal.

10 characters, 10 powers

Every character has their own power on the F key. No hidden stats beyond that; the rest is up to you.

  • Puf — Fluff Cloud: bursts into feathers and vanishes for 3 seconds.

  • Alev — Flare Up: blasts high into the air in an instant.

  • Balbal — Stone Wall: raises a stone block in front of you for 6 seconds.

  • Tekgöz — Hypnosis: whoever you look at gets their steering flipped for 1.5 seconds.

  • Buz — Ice Trap: drops a slippery ice pool; anyone stepping on it slides out of control.

  • Dikko — Spike Field: leaves spike patches behind; anyone who steps on them slows down.

  • Kıvırcık — Headbutt Quake: slams the ground and blasts everyone around away.

  • Hayalet — Ghost Walk: passes through anything for 3 seconds.

  • Tosbik — Shell Ball: tucks into the shell and rolls forward like a ball; whoever hits it can't tag you, and the slap launches you far away.

  • Tilki — Fake Twin: leaves a motionless copy of itself in place for 4 seconds; bots and startled players run at it.

6 modes

  • Free For All — classic. Time runs out, IT is eliminated.

  • Teams — red and blue. One team freezes, the other thaws.

  • Infection — get tagged and you become IT too. Last one standing wins.

  • Freeze Tag — tagged players freeze until a friend thaws them.

  • Crown Grab — one crown, everyone chases it. Hold it 20 s to win.

  • Last One Standing — no tagger. Traps take your three lives. Stay alive.

12 maps, each with its own rules

Manor, Park, Planet, Ship, Glacier, Factory, Water Tower, Windmill, Volcano, Cavern, Arena, Obstacle Course.

The ship rolls while an island slowly draws alongside. The water tower floods. The arena collapses ring by ring. Lava launches you skyward. Every map breaks you differently — or pick SHUFFLE and get a new one each round.

Nobody online?

Bots are a core feature, not filler bolted on later. Easy, normal and hard — on hard they even slap each other. The game is the same whether you're alone or with nine friends.

As you play

Every match earns XP and Panic Points. Levelling up unlocks new perks: faster running, higher jumps, a shorter dash cooldown. Spend your points in the shop on slap skins, tagger trails, pop styles, name colours, badges and extra perks — harder slaps, less knockback, a shorter power cooldown. Only one perk at a time; nobody gets to stack combos.

At the end of a match your photo is taken on the podium, saved to your match history, and you can watch the replay.

What's in the box

  • 2-10 players online (via Steam — room code or friend invite)

  • Fully playable solo against bots

  • 12 maps + Shuffle mode

  • 6 game modes

  • 10 characters, each with their own power

  • 15 languages

  • Match photos, match history and replays

Short matches, loud laughing, one-more-round energy. Don't be IT. Or be IT — just catch someone while you're still small.

Regular updates are on the way, with new maps, new shop items and game mode improvements.

The evernight has arrived in Mehen, the Fortress City.

Please uncover the secrets of the citadel city of Mehen and bring tomorrow's sun.

Take down the stars and send them back to the night sky.

Overcome the trials of ancient ruins that have occurred everywhere and inherit the power and memory of the ruins.

Perfect Guard

Guard just before being hit by an enemy attack and block it out perfectly.

Parry

Start charging heavy attack just before they are hit by an strong attack of enemy for parry.

Counter

Guard the previous attack and dash or jump within the warning area to counter at the same time as dodging.

Grow with multiple equipment that changes the combat experience beyond simple numerical changes, such as artifacts that have different effects depending on the direction of mounting or alchemy that gives additional effects when using an elixir.

You didn’t return to remember.

You returned to survive what you forgot.

In MIA: Memory Fragments, moving forward means stepping back into moments you don’t fully remember. Familiar places repeat, conversations feel incomplete, and the world reacts when you get too close to the truth.

Some paths open when you face what happened.
Others awaken something that wants you to stop digging.

Reconstruct the story and uncover the truth

There are no long explanations.

Understanding comes from revisiting shared moments, noticing what repeats, and confronting the fragments that refuse to stay hidden.


Escape When Memory Turns Hostile

Not all memories want to be uncovered.

When MIA’s darkest side appears, exploration turns into survival. Run, hide, and escape as the rules of the world break.

Explore to Move Forward

Explore interconnected environments and observe your surroundings carefully.

Progress by navigating spaces, examining details, and interacting with key elements that allow you to move deeper into the memory.

Overcome Blocked Paths

Progress is often shaped by interaction.

At certain moments, you can engage with specific elements through short challenges that add variety, restore missing fragments, and let you move forward.

The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell truth from denial.

Face the memories… or stay trapped inside them forever.

Add MIA to your wishlist!

From the Creator of Turn Based Boxing: Tactics, fight in playground scraps to packed stadiums in a gory, tactics-driven Mixed Martial Arts simulation. Use real MMA strategy, experience MMA history, discover and challenge fighters inspired by the living, the dead, and the legendary.

Step into the violent world of underground Mixed Martial Arts. A realistic turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death.

Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

The Most Savage MMA Game:

This is a hard game. Some fighters will die.

Create Your Gym:

Assemble a diverse team of fighters with unique skills and styles. Each fighter contributes to earning cash for the gym. Use cash to train your fighters and bribe the commission.

Recruit and Customize Talent:

Scour the globe for the most talented fighters to join your gym. From seasoned veterans to up and coming young studs, every fighter has unique strengths, weaknesses, and personalities.

Over 125 Perks / Endless Fighter Builds:

Perks are special abilities that enhance a fighter's performance in different aspects of the game. These can range from increased stamina and power to improved defensive maneuvers or tactical advantages in the cage. As the manager,  choose which perks to enable. Synergize perks with each fighter's talents, weaknesses, fighting style, and the gyms overall goals.

Increasing Stats by Training (Level up after each win):

Each stat contributes to a fighter's overall performance in the cage and can be improved. Some stats have stars, meaning the fighter is talented, granting a higher skill ceiling.

Death:

When a fighter sustains injuries during matches they risk death. Fighters age over time. At 60 years old one is vulnerable to death from injuries. At 100 they will die.

Complete Quests and Unlock Strategies:

Meet quest criteria to unlock strategies that any fighter in your gym can utilize. Strategies can be changed before each round of fighting.

Climb the Ranking and win the Undisputed Championship:

With perseverance, strategy, and a little bit of luck, you'll lead your gym to greatness and cement your legacy as one of the greatest MMA managers of all time.

Join the community and share your fighters and compete in tournaments.

MOLY is a VR puzzle-solving immersive rowing simulator that uses VR rowing gameplay to represent the authors' perceptions of the world and their aspirations for the future as they come of age.

The five levels of this game represent the different stages of the road to knowledge. The game itself is both the riddle and the riddle. It is a search for the commonality of people of the same age, “MOLY” has our tracing back to the confusion, the questioning of the future, and the major propositions that we have experienced will be presented in the game. We wish you the courage to face the chaos, pack your bags, start again after each bumpy ride, and usher in a new perception of the world.

Chapter I: Set Sail

"Set Sail" is the state we find ourselves in when venturing into new territories. It signifies a fresh start, breaking free from our previous context and representing numerous beginnings like being in the middle of a lake, the transition from "abundance" to "simplicity." With each new beginning, we reset our identities and repeatedly question ourselves, "Who am I? "Opening my eyes again, I see that the world appears vast and pure, and I can vaguely discern the direction. In a realm of tranquility and innocence, we paddle and navigate our way forward, heading towards new paths.

Chapter II: Harmonic

Our understanding gradually expands, and feelings of solitude and pride accompany us. As we navigate through these emotions, we faintly hear voices similar to our own- a chorus of companions. Finally, we encounter each other on the journey, forming a delicate partnership. In the air, our collision ignites fervent sparks. The experience of traveling alongside friends fills us with immense inspiration and guides us away from the island of loneliness.

Chapter III: Exhaustion

I continue to venture more profound, but the journey could be smoother. Along the way, I lose my sense of direction and am unable to proceed further. Therefore, I attempt to change the combination of conditions, seeking to break free from the seemingly bright yet confined circumstances. As the puzzle pieces gradually come together, the world before me shatters, and I break free from the predicament, only to find myself amid an even greater mystery.

Chapter IV: Multiply

Looking back on my experiences, I unravel the threads of enlightenment, attempting to find the root of my desire to move forward. I realize that I didn't make a definitive decision to move forward at a particular moment; instead, all my past experiences have shaped the "me" in this present moment, keeping me in a state of progression. Time flies by swiftly; we enrich ourselves through repetition, oscillating between hope and struggle, relying on the accumulation of knowledge and the passage of time.

Chapter V: Drift

I escape the realm of memories, only to be engulfed by chaos again. I catch sight of new brightness and witness the unexpected. The identity of youth grants us abilities that symbolize and differentiate are both unique from one another. and countless.

Real-time multiplayer FreeCell

Sit down at a virtual table. Everyone gets the same hand. Race to solve it. Watch the leaderboard update live as you play.

FreeCell, with people.

"It's been amazing playing against someone live. It gives you that extra rush when you're playing against a real person—pure dopamine!"

— VulcanoLord, the first player to beat the dev

What's in the box

Single-player FreeCell. The game you know, in a modern build — clean animations, smart auto-move, undo support, watch replays of your best games offline.

Help on Easy. New to FreeCell? Say yes to help and the best move glows gold, with a line on what it does. Arrows show which moves keep the deal winnable, and if a deal can't be won any more, you can go back to where it still could.

Multiplayer tables. Invite friends to a Group Play lobby. Everyone draws the same deals. First to win, lowest moves, best time — all tracked, all visible.

Arena Queue. Get matched, race live, climb the global leaderboard.

Arena Hour, every night. The arena lights up at a fixed hour daily — shown in your local time — and the dev is in the queue. Race him.

Daily Challenge. Same deal for every player worldwide, every day. One shot.

Rivalries. The leaderboard remembers who beat you — and gives you the rematch.

Quests. Personal challenges dealt from your own numbers — win in fewer moves than your recent best, clear it faster, finish without an undo. Each one asks for a different style of play.

Beat the Dev. Beat the developer in a live race and earn one of the rarest badges in the game, plus the Steam achievement. He plays every night. Good luck.

Cross-platform. One account across Steam, Windows, Mac, and Linux — plus Android on Google Play and iOS on the App Store. Your stats and rivalries follow you.

Times you can trust. Verified from the watchable replay of every run — millisecond-precision timing. Photo finishes are decided by thousandths, and every result on the board is watchable.

Free to download and play.

Play every difficulty, Hardcore included, and rank on every leaderboard without paying a cent. No ads. No "watch a video to undo." No login required to play. That is how it works today; if it ever changes, we will say so plainly and ahead of time.

Everything competitive is free: ranked stats, every leaderboard, rivalries, Hardcore, your whole history. An optional supporter membership comes later and buys depth on top of the game, never access to it. There is no billing in the game yet. One flat tier when it arrives. No microtransactions. No cosmetic gacha. No "premium" upsells inside the game.

A one-person, veteran-owned studio, actively developed

Patches ship weekly. The in-game feedback button reaches the developer directly — we read every message and most ideas turn into real changes within days. The community Discord (linked from the in-game menu) is where we discuss what's coming next.

What you feed is your build.

MUTARIUM is a feed-and-defend roguelite. You run a lab aquarium full of specimens that mutate based on what you feed them — and the lab's failed experiments keep breaking in to eat everything you've grown.

You never command your fish. You feed them, they fight. Every pellet is a build decision.

  • Three feeds, one build — MEAT makes killers, GLOW makes earners, ORE makes walls. The mix decides each fish's mutation branch: pure lines, hybrids, and a KING rank for those who push their luck.
  • Read the forecast, change the diet — every wave is announced before it hits. Chargers punish your shots, spitters hit from outside your tank line, splitters punish your finishers. Your counter-pick is what you feed next.
  • Overfeeding is real — max out a specimen and keep stuffing it, and it goes berserk. Your best fish becomes the invader. You made it; now deal with it.
  • Bosses drop sealed specimen eggs — hatch them to unlock new species (Guppy, Veiltail, Ironjaw, and one still sealed), each with its own mutation tree and a codex to fill.
  • Short runs, long descent — a run is one dive through the facility: the Isolation Tank, the Deep Vats… and four sealed floors below. The elevator keeps going down.

Heads-up on tone: mutation is cartoon body horror. Specimens visibly deform and grow clustered eyes as they advance. No gore, no realistic injury.

Insaniquarium invented the feed-and-defend aquarium in 2001, and nothing has carried it forward since. MUTARIUM is a love letter to that genre — rebuilt as a roguelite, where the feeding itself is the build.

Your cat has done it again.

This time, the rebellious troublemaker has scattered all 5,158 games and consoles across your video game supermarket. During the incident, the culprit also managed to get trapped inside the claw machine.

Now there is only one way to get your cat back: clean up the entire store.

A 5,158 Item Catastrophe

Walk through a store buried beneath games and consoles. Pick up scattered discs and cartridges, inspect their boxes, identify their platforms, and return them to the correct sections.

Each shelf has room for up to three different games and ten copies of each. Group matching titles together, decide how to arrange the collection, and watch the store slowly recover from the world’s largest feline-related shelving accident.

Know Your Games

The store is packed with parody covers and references to video game history. Examine boxes in your hands, discover jokes inspired by different gaming eras, and sort a collection spanning generations of discs, cartridges, and consoles.

Work Smarter

Correctly filled shelves unlock new abilities that help you deal with the enormous mess. Find matching copies, highlight suitable shelves, sort the games you carry, and place items more efficiently.

The job begins one box at a time-but it won’t stay that slow for long.

Three Safes. Three Digits. One Trapped Cat.

The store is divided into three areas, each connected to a locked safe. Fill the shelves correctly to open all three safes and recover the digits hidden inside.

Enter the complete three-digit code into the claw machine, open the lock, and rescue the cat responsible for all of this.

Take as long as you need. There are no timers, no game over, and no customers demanding to speak to the manager.

Key Features

  • Organize 5,158  games and consoles-all present at once

  • Sort games by platform and group matching copies

  • Discover parody covers and gaming-industry references

  • Unlock abilities by correctly filling shelves

  • Rescue the cat and try not to think about who will clean up next time

  • Play without timers, failure states, or pressure

MaMills is four-in-a-row in 3D: drop pieces onto vertical sticks, let gravity stack them, and line up four in any direction, even straight through the cube. Outsmart the Machine across five difficulties, solve 40 one-solution puzzles, or challenge a friend on the couch, over LAN or with Steam Remote Play Together.

This game is a tribute to my late Grandmother (aka Mami), who I used to play this game with. I loved it then, and I love it now; I hope you find some joy in it too! ❤️

Four-in-a-row, but the board goes up too

MaMills is a calm, controller-first board game. You drop coloured cylinders onto a 4×4 grid of vertical sticks, gravity stacks them, and the first player to line up four wins.

Because the pieces stack, every stick is also a column, every row of sticks is also a plane, and a line can run corner to corner straight through the cube. Sixteen sticks, sixty-four places, seventy-six ways to win.

I learned it from my grandmother, Mami. It is an old rule set that people have played for generations. This is that game, made digital, with a clear layout to be comfortable to play.

How a match goes

  • Pick a stick, drop a cylinder. A beam and a ghost piece show exactly where it will land. Four pieces fill a stick.

  • Four in a row wins. Rows, columns, vertical stacks, plane diagonals and the four cube diagonals all count, on every level. 76 lines in total.

  • Rotate the board, or lock the angle. Orbit freely to read a position from any side, or freeze the camera and play from the view you like.

  • Hint shows every live threat. Against the Machine, one press rims the opponent's three-in-a-rows and marks the stick that blocks each one. Block it, or race it.

  • Pause any time. The match holds still while you step away.

Four ways to play

  • The Machine – five levels from Beginner to Expert. Beginner leaves room to learn; Expert does not.

  • Hotseat – two players on one device. Pass the controller or the Steam Deck back and forth.

  • LAN – two devices on the same network, each with its own screen. One hosts, the other joins. Each device needs its own copy of the game.

  • Steam Remote Play Together – invite a Steam friend to join your game from their own device. They do not need to own the game.

There is no chat of any kind, text or voice. You can only play it with people you already know.

Learn it in a few minutes

A short story-driven tutorial teaches the rules inside a real setup, one control at a time, and ends on a card of the four winning shapes.

Puzzles

A mode of its own. Forty positions in five levels, eight each, from a win in one move to a double threat that wins in two. Every puzzle has exactly one answer, so you know when you have found it.

Accessibility

A board game is for everyone at the table, so MaMills tries to make room for everyone.

  • Never colour alone. Patterned cylinders, stripes on one side and dots on the other, and a colour-blind-safe blue and orange palette. Here every theme wears its patterns, Halloween included.

  • Text size from 85% to 130%, applied to every label and button.

  • Reduce motion, opaque backgrounds behind every dialog, mono audio, adjustable drop speed, and an optional X, Y, Z readout of the highlighted stick.

  • Your system settings, respected. On Windows and macOS, the first time you start MaMills it picks up reduce motion, mono audio, reduce transparency and differentiate without colour. Change them any time in Settings.

  • Always show threats keeps Hint on for your whole turn against the Machine.

  • No time pressure. Turns are never timed, you can pause any time, and the Steam Deck can suspend mid-match.

  • English and Hungarian interface. There is no speech, so nothing to dub, and no screen reader.

Every action wears its button

Full keyboard and gamepad rebinding. Every action shows its button on screen in its own colour, and the glyph follows whatever you are holding: Steam Deck, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch or keyboard.

Make it yours

  • Four palettes – Classic red and blue, Violet, a colour-blind-safe blue and orange, and Gold & Silver, which unlocks when you beat Expert.

  • Eight drop sounds – pick the one you like, from a soft bop to glass and cherry. A background track you can turn down or off.

  • Two loading screens – a tumbling cube of cylinders, or the windmill with cylinder sails.

Our first theme: Halloween

Halloween debuts in the Steam Next Fest demo and comes with the game at release. The whole game turns to night: spiders against pumpkins on a moonlit board, with candles at the corners.

Cobwebs hang in the corners of every screen, and a little spider walks the title of the main menu.

Prefer the familiar pieces? Cylinders in every theme keeps cylinders inside the night scene. More seasonal themes to come.

Built for Steam Deck

Designed and tested on the Deck from the first day: controller-first, readable at the Deck's native resolution, and safe to suspend mid-match. It plays just as well on the desktop with a keyboard and mouse or any gamepad.

On Steam

  • 21 achievements – 15 you can see coming and 6 hidden ones for the sneaky lines.

  • Lifetime statistics and three leaderboards: longest win streak, total wins against the Machine, and fewest placements to beat Expert.

  • Steam Cloud keeps your settings and progress with you between machines.

One price, the whole game, no microtransactions.

Mad Toy House is a roguelite build-crafting game that combines the wave-based survival of Brotato with the build-making gameplay of The Bazaar. Choose from hundreds of weapons and items to create your own unique playstyle, making every run a fresh challenge.

Massive Build Variety

Size, position, bonus effects, and more: these dimensions combine to create hundreds of different items. Carefully choose from them to build a one-of-a-kind strategy, turning limited equipment slots into endless build possibilities.

Patch Your Items

Some items can apply their unique effects as “patches” onto other items, creating powerful synergies where 1+1 becomes greater than 2. Every run is full of unexpected combinations and surprises.

Meta Progression

Build and customize your collection of special toys outside of combat, adding more depth and variety to your battle experience.

Night Falls is a multiplayer social deduction game set in a village where no one is who they claim to be. Gather up to 16 players, get handed a secret role, and fight to survive or to win as the Town, the Mafia, or something far worse.

Every night the village sleeps, and killers move in the dark. Every morning the survivors gather to argue, accuse, and send someone to the gallows. Read the room, sell your lie, and figure out who's bluffing before the body count climbs.

Everyone has a role. Someone is always lying

Over 20 unique roles split across three sides — each with its own powers, secrets, and way to win:

  • Town — protect the innocent and hunt the killers. Revive the dead as the Doctor, jail and execute a suspect as the Jailor, read houses as the Investigator, inspect corpses as the Detective, snap evidence as the Cameraman, and more.

  • Mafia — a secret team that knows each other and picks the town apart. Stalk with a knife, break down doors, frame the innocent, silence loud players, and disguise your kills.

  • Werewolf — a lone predator with its own agenda. It transforms after dark, tears across the village, and hunts on its own terms — answering to no one.

  • Jester — a neutral with one deranged goal: get yourself executed. The Jester wins only by goading the town into voting you to the gallows.

Your powers play out in the world

Abilities aren't faceless menu clicks. The Doctor kneels over a body to bring it back. The Jailor straps a prisoner into the electric chair. The Cameraman's photo is pinned to the town board at dawn for everyone to study. The Mafia breaks through doors in the night, and the Werewolf tears across the village. What you do leaves traces — if someone's watching.

Talk your way out - or into a grave

Live voice chat is the real battlefield. Speak to those nearby, scheme privately with your Mafia, or sweat through a Jailor's interrogation. The best lie is the one everyone believes.

A village that breathes

A moonlit town drenched in fog, flickering lamps, and long shadows. Own your own house, learn the streets, and use the dark to your advantage — because some roles see the night more clearly than others.

Features

  • Online multiplayer for up to 16 players

  • 20+ hidden roles across Town, Mafia, and Neutral factions

  • A day/night loop of secret night actions, heated discussion, and public votes

  • Proximity + secret role-based voice chat

  • Hands-on, world-interactive role abilities

  • An atmospheric moonlit village built for paranoia

When night falls, trust is the most dangerous thing you can give. Will you survive until dawn?

Play as a magic cat and break through endless hordes!

Witch Cat: Endless Breakthrough is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Control a magic cat, dodge dense enemy swarms, and craft powerful builds with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and reforge gear in the hub, take on harder challenges, and hunt for better loot to push your limits.

Fast-paced combat — movement is key

Classic survivor action:attacks plus manual dodging through crowded enemy waves

Varied monsters and boss mechanics

Cartoon pixel art with snappy hit feedback. Easy to learn, hard to master.

Strategy cards × bond synergies

Pick 1 of 3 cards after each wave — White, Blue, Purple, and Gold tiers

Many bond schools: Element, Collision, Orbs, Summoning, and more — unlock powerful effects as you collect

Every run can be a completely different build — fresh experience each time

Meta progression that keeps you growing

Account talent tree: four branches with permanent stat and combat boosts

Weapons and gear: Common → Rare → Epic → Radiance → Mythic — quality tiers unlock as you progress

Reforge mythic gear sub-affixes to fine-tune your perfect loadout

Three modes, endless challenges

Main Story: advance chapters to raise loot quality caps and beat chapter bosses for chest rewards

Abyss: challenge Abyss bosses and earn Mythic weapon shards

Endless: survive wave after wave — how far can you go?

Ready to break through?

Choose your cards, stack your bonds, gear up — your endless run starts now.

A party based roguelike auto battler stuffed with wonder and menace. Summon a band of unlikely heroes, chart a world that refuses to stay the same, hoard enchanted loot, and put down the ancient evil warping the realm.



Pick your four starting heroes each run, then grow your party on the road. Every hero brings their own active and passive skills, and where you stand them in formation changes how fights play out. Balance tanks, casters, and rangers into a company that clicks.



Your party fights on its own. You decide everything else, who stands where, what they wield, and when to drag a potion into the fray. Petrify, poison, silence, and confuse your enemies, or suffer the same. From slime cats to melon dragons, over 100 monsters want you dead.



Strip fallen monsters for parts and claim 120+ weapons, armors, and trinkets. Visit the blacksmith to push gear up the rarity ladder, from humble White finds to Epics that define your whole build.



Collect 80+ artifacts that bend the rules for your whole party. Court the blessings of strange gods, use orbs that awaken hidden skill levels, and stack a hoard of coins, censers, and scarves no sane adventurer should own.



Three acts, three colossal bosses. Face the ancient turtle Mysticus Tortalis, the Hydra, and the Chimera, while elites like the Golden Sphinx and the Crystal Colossus guard the roads between.

The game includes:

  • 17+ unique heroes to recruit and rally
  • 120+ items to equip and forge
  • 80+ artifacts that shape your whole party
  • 100+ monsters, plus elites and 3 colossal bosses
  • 40+ map events, from cursed wells to blacksmith bargains
  • 70+ hero skills across actives and passives

Technical: This game is designed for 1920 x 1080 displays. but should work on other display sizes.

ABOUT THIS GAME

Break ore, grow your crew, and turn a magical mine into a lively mining operation!

MagiMine Orchestra is an active incremental mining game that combines hands-on mining with a colorful crew of automated specialists.

Click or hold to break ore, collect the resources scattered across the mine, and reinvest your earnings into stronger tools, more valuable ore veins, and a larger workforce.

BUILD YOUR MINING ORCHESTRA

Each specialist supports the mine in a different way:

• Haulers collect dropped resources.
• Drill Operators keep drilling until an ore deposit breaks.
• Blasters throw explosives that damage nearby ore.
• Arcane Miners unleash magical shockwaves across a wide area.

EXPAND THE MINE

Begin with stone, then progress through copper, iron, silver, gold, and increasingly rare magical ores. Improve resource yields and mining capacity while unlocking new specialists and powerful upgrades.

COMBOS AND FEVER

Keep mining to build combos and increase the efficiency of the entire operation. Unlock Fever through prestige to fill the mine with ore and enjoy bursts of high-speed progression.

PRESTIGE AND GROW STRONGER

Convert your progress into Prestige Points and begin the next run with permanent upgrades. Unlock specialist inheritance, stronger abilities, and new systems that let your mine grow faster with every cycle.

KEY FEATURES

• Switch freely between active clicking and automatic mining
• Recruit four distinct specialist classes
• Discover ten increasingly valuable ore tiers
• Build combos and trigger powerful Fever runs
• Unlock permanent upgrades through prestige
• Complete goals and achievements
• Track your progress with detailed statistics
• Continue playing at your own pace with autosaving

CARD GAME STRATEGY MEETS PARTY GAME FUN!

A wild party card game for 2-4 players where magical cards can affect both the match and what players experience on screen. But watch out: your opponents can counter your attacks, steal your cards, or unleash epic combos on you!

 

BLUR THEIR VISION

BE STRATEGIC: MAKE COMBOS & GET BUFFS

Chain matching cards into combos and gain power-ups from Item Cards.

FLASH THEM

SUMMON METEOR SHOWERS

COUNTER ATTACKS

Players can respond with Counter Cards that deny, reflect, or steal an incoming card.

WIPE ALL

JUMPSCARE

Deal physical damage to the character and emotional damage to the player!

EASY TO LEARN, JUMP RIGHT IN

Magic Color Merge Puzzle reimagines the classic color sort genre with a stunning, immersive twist. Whether you prefer the ease of traditional clicks or the tactile thrill of pouring vibrant liquids by hand, this game lets you play your way - just like handling the real thing! But be careful… drop a bottle, and you might be in for a cleanup!

Journey through increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and creativity. Earn crystals as rewards, then use them to research and craft a magical potion series—your ultimate goal! Completing potion sets unlocks powerful boosters like double XP, extra tubes, and more.

Enjoy three new daily challenges every day for extra rewards and a fresh gameplay twist.

Want to experiment freely? Create your own custom games by choosing the number of tubes, colors, and game modes—perfect for strategizing or just relaxing fun.

Customize your experience with different liquid styles (normal, minimal bubbles, or color-only) and tube designs (reflective or classic). All set to a selection of varied music tracks that evolve with your journey.

Ready to pour, sort, and craft your way to magical mastery?

Gather the elements. Open the portals. Outshine your rival.

In a world where raw magic drifts on the wind, the old portals lie dormant — waiting for a mage with the patience to coax them open. Each turn you reach into the swirling Animus and draw the elements of creation: Air, Earth, Fire, Life, Shadow, and Water. Channel them into your crystals, feed them into sleeping portals, and watch the gateways blaze to life one by one. The first archmage to bind their power to seven portals brings the contest to its end — but raw count is never enough. Only the sharpest planner walks away with the highest glory.

Magic Portals is a fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting and tactical scoring. Easy to learn in a single match, deep enough to chase for a hundred more.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Draw the Animus

At the heart of every turn is the Animus — a shared pool of elemental energy that every mage draws from. Pull symbols one by one and decide how far to press your luck: stop early and play it safe, or keep drawing to fuel a bigger play. The elements you gather become crystals, which you place onto the symbol slots of waiting portal cards. Match a portal's full requirement and it ignites — claimed, scored, and yours.

Six true elements flow through the Animus — Air, Earth, Fire, Life, Shadow, and Water — alongside rare Wildcards that bend to whatever you need most.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Four Colors of Magic

  • Blue — Attunement. Permanent portals that teach a chosen element to act as a wildcard for the rest of the match. Open them early and every future play gets easier.

  • Purple — Power. Pure, demanding portals worth the highest raw points. No tricks, just glory for the mage who can pay their price.

  • Green — Foresight. Quiet portals that score nothing now but multiply at the very end — rewarding you for the elements you hoard and the portal colors you collect. Plant them early, reap them late.

  • Yellow — Sorcery. Instant bursts of magic: conjure crystals from nowhere, place them anywhere, rearrange the board, or tear open extra portals on the spot. The improviser's school.

Layer the schools together — Blue to fuel, Yellow to accelerate, Purple for the heavy haul, Green to cash it all in — and a clean engine starts to hum.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Open the Portals

Build your tableau, complete portals, and chase the bonus rewards that crown a well-rounded strategy: extra points for finishing whole color sets, and escalating rewards for the sheer number of portals you light up. Reaching seven completed portals triggers the final reckoning — then every Green effect resolves, every bonus is tallied, and the mage with the highest score is named victor.

There's no hiding behind luck here. The Animus is shared, the board is open, and every point is earned by the choices you make.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Game Modes

  • Single-player vs AI. Hone your craft against a capable computer opponent — perfect for learning the schools, testing a new strategy, or playing offline whenever you like.

  • Online Multiplayer. Challenge real mages in head-to-head duels on a fair, server-authoritative match engine. Same rules, same draws, no cheating — pure skill on both sides of the table.

  • Ranked Matchmaking. Step into timed competitive matches and prove where you stand. Classic turn timers keep duels sharp and decisive.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Why You'll Stay

  • Five minutes to learn, ages to master — simple rules, layered decisions.

  • Every match is different — a shifting central row and a shared element pool mean no two games play the same.

  • Skill over luck — open information and shared draws reward planning, not fortune.

  • Quick, clean duels — built for "just one more game."

The portals are waiting. Will you be the one to open them?

A Roguelike deck-building game where you combine spells of different elements to forge powerful new attacks. It features flexible, easy-to-trigger Elemental Combos alongside rarer, stronger Unique Combos. Customize your build by purchasing and arranging relics for a wide variety of effects, and gain global buffs by upgrading hand types or acquiring Lore. Shape your path to victory based entirely on your personal playstyle.

Dynamic Deck-Building

Collect and combine spell, relic, and Lore cards to adapt your deck on the fly. Make rare combos easier to trigger, boost standard spells to deal insane damage, or chain unique synergies to smash boss after boss—each with its own mechanics.

Elemental Combos

Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth—each element possesses its own strengths and weaknesses. Combine cards of different elements to execute a wide array of combos. Some turn single-target spells into room-clearing AoE attacks, while others trigger tactical effects tailored to the situation. Elemental Combos offer the game's most versatile blend of offense and defense, allowing the exact same hand to yield completely different strategic outcomes based on your tactical judgment.

Unique Combos

The unique Catalyst mechanics evolve basic elemental combos into rare, game-changing spells. You can also pair specific cards to trigger Unique Combos that are far stronger than Elemental Combos, delivering pure, overpowered combat satisfaction.

"Magua: Twenty Sorrows" is a combat strategy game that blends Roguelike elements and auto-battler combat.

Assemble a team from ten factions and three classes, and make them synergize with each other.

Strategically pick units to activate synergies and create insane combinations that boost your team!

Forge an unstoppable team that will crush all eighty bosses in the game.




An auto-battler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team.
Upgrade your team and defeat ever stronger enemies in this Roguelike adventure.


Combine, Open Packs, Assemble

Strategically build your team to defeat increasingly difficult bosses, each with it's own mechanics that your team needs to counter.

Every fight is a puzzle. Should you use Ice units to slow the boss down, Nature units to boost your team's regeneration, or maybe add a third ranged unit for more damage? Find out for yourself!



Perks That Change Everything

Perks do very different things for your team: some boost stats, others change your playstyle completely. Unlock them and see which ones suit you.




Extremely High Replay Value

Every run is a new tactical experiment. You will need to optimize your team to keep progressing, and every boss has different abilities that call for a different approach. One run you can build a full crit team that kills the boss before it can blink. Next, the boss counters every crit attack and makes that build useless. Find out what works and what doesn't.

A single-player mahjong game where you build combos, score points, and get stronger every round.

Mahjong Rush is a solo mahjong roguelike. No opponents, no discarding into someone else's win. Every table has a target score: make runs and sets from your tiles, play them to score, and clear the table once you hit the target.

HOW SCORING WORKS

Every set you play scores Chips × Mult. • Tiles you Chow, Pong or Kong stay on the table and boost every play after that • Complete a winning hand (a Hu) and your multiplier jumps way up • Harder hands score more — Full Flush, Seven Pairs, Thirteen Orphans and more

GET STRONGER AS YOU GO

Between tables, visit the shop to make the next one easier: • Flower cards (80+): always active — e.g. "honor tiles give extra Mult", "calls give more Chips" • Talismans (20+): one-time use — e.g. swap a tile, redraw your hand • Treasures (30+): last the whole run, and can be upgraded

The shop is random every time, so no two runs play the same.

CLIMB THROUGH THE MAP

Each round has a map, and you choose where to go next: regular tables, high-stakes tables, bounties, mystery events and shops. Every round ends with a boss table. Each boss adds one rule against you — a smaller hand, coins lost for discarding — so you'll need to change how you play.

NEVER PLAYED MAHJONG?

A step-by-step tutorial teaches you to read tiles, call Chow / Pong / Kong, and make a Hu. Turn on Assist Mode and every tile shows its number.

ALSO INCLUDES • Multiple difficulty tiers, with harder winning hands unlocked further in • Earn XP every run and level up to unlock new Flower cards • Leaderboards for top score and fastest clear • 12 languages and Steam Cloud saves

Game Features

★ Deckbuilding and Board Tactics
A fusion of CCG deckbuilding and dynamic battles. Collect your favorite Battle Maiden cards and assemble a powerful deck. Combine each character's unique abilities with Astral Map talents and resource management to unleash devastating offensives on the battlefield.

★ Card Play, Positioning, and Board Actions
Once played, cards move and engage on the board according to set rules. Master the timing and positioning of each play to guide your team to victory.
Equipment cards empower your minions, while spell cards deal damage or trigger special effects to press your advantage even further.

★ Life-or-Death Decisions
Manage your battlefield resources and make the most of your limited Action Points (AP) each turn.
Magic Ore nodes are hotly contested objectives. Secure Magic Ore to unleash powerful cards.
When the battle reaches a stalemate or a mighty foe closes in, use Sacrifice Summoning to call forth powerful Greater and Mythic cards and turn the tide in an instant!

★ Rogue-lite Expeditions and Astral Map Progression
Every expedition is full of uncertainty: randomly generated routes, unknown encounters, and random empowering relics. Every choice will determine the fate of your Battle Maidens.
Earn resources through battle to unlock Astral Map talents and new cards, then build an ever-stronger, more versatile lineup.

Background Story

This continent was once under the Goddess's grace, protected by the "Battle Maidens"—warriors possessing unrivaled power.
But the demons rose against her. They corrupted the "World Crystal"—the very pillar of reality—suppressing the Goddess's divine power. Without her protection, the Battle Maidens' territories fell one by one, their people's minds corrupted and brought under demonic control.

In their darkest hour, the Freedom Alliance used a sacred relic to perform an ancient ritual to summon a hero from another world. Only a "Summoner", bearing the power of the Goddess, can help the Battle Maidens awaken their dormant divine power and repel the demons.

This is a journey of redemption, and the final holy war to reclaim the world's light!

Four Territories

To open the gateway to ultimate darkness, you must lead the allied forces in reclaiming four territories occupied by demons, rescuing and awakening those trapped by evil:

  • Iron-Oath Kingdom (Sacred Crown Princess Knight): A once-glorious fortress and an iron-blooded bulwark. The Sacred Crown Princess Knight is trapped amid the flames of war, awaiting salvation through the power of her vow.
  • Elf Forest (Elven Saint Priestess): An ancient, sacred forest that has been home to the elves for a thousand years. The pure Elven Saint Priestess has been sealed by dark magic and stripped of her power.
  • Lava Canyon (Dragonflame Princess): A raging, scorching canyon inhabited by flame dragons and creatures of fire. The noble Dragonflame Princess battles wicked hellfire while enduring the searing agony of black flames.
  • Magic Tower (Grand Elementalist): A mystical hall devoted to the pursuit of truth, and the sacred sanctuary of every mage on the continent. The mighty Grand Elementalist has lost control of her magic, and her magic circles no longer obey her commands, yet she continues to fight the demons.

Defeat the demons occupying each territory, restore the Battle Maidens' power, and welcome them into your ranks. Together, march on the Infernal Citadel and face the Demon Lord!

The keys are yours. So is the seller note.

You just bought a tired neighborhood laundromat with worn machines, thin margins, and a reputation that needs rebuilding. Now you have to turn it into a business worth owning.

Main Street Operator is a first-person business management simulation about taking over one struggling laundromat and making it work. Walk the floor, clean the store, diagnose broken machines, pull the coin boxes, manage cash flow, modernize the operation, and watch customers respond to the business you build.

FIX WHAT'S BROKEN

Every machine matters. Washers and dryers wear down, develop problems, and eventually demand your attention.

Inspect symptoms, diagnose faults, repair equipment yourself when you can, overhaul aging machines, or pay for professional help when the job is bigger than your toolbox.

A broken machine isn't just scenery. It's capacity you aren't earning from.

RUN THE FLOOR

This isn't a business you manage from a spreadsheet alone.

Walk through the laundromat in first person. Clean dirty areas, interact with machines, collect money, check equipment, and watch customers move through the store using the washers, dryers, seating, and folding areas around you.

The condition of the floor reflects the business you're running.

MANAGE A REAL SMALL BUSINESS

Revenue is only half the story.

You have rent, utilities, maintenance, supplies, upgrades, and a seller-financed note that comes due whether the month went well or not.

Set prices. Protect your cash reserves. Decide when to spend and when to wait. Manage your own financial needs without starving the business that has to support you.

Every month closes with the numbers your decisions created.

MODERNIZE THE LAUNDROMAT

Start with an aging coin-operated store and gradually improve it.

Upgrade payment systems, add useful amenities, improve the customer experience, replace tired equipment, and turn a worn-out laundromat into a neighborhood business people actually want to use.

Your improvements aren't just numbers on a menu — the store changes around you as you build it.

WIN BACK THE NEIGHBORHOOD

Keep the machines running, the store clean, prices reasonable, and customers happy.

A better operation earns a better reputation. A better reputation brings more traffic. As the business improves, new opportunities and new pressures begin to appear.

The neighborhood remembers how you run the place.

MAKE THE BUSINESS YOURS

Main Street Operator is built around one focused business rather than an endless empire.

Pay down the seller note. Build equity. Decide what kind of operator you want to be. And when the business can finally stand on its own, decide whether to keep pushing, pay it off, or take the right offer and walk away.

There is a finish line.

How you reach it — and what the laundromat is worth when you do — depends on the choices you made along the way.

There is a monster in the bay. His name is Gary.

You are one man in one small boat with one bow. Gary is roughly the size of a district. This is not a fair fight, and everyone involved knows it — including Gary, who finds the whole thing a little tedious.

So you do the only sensible thing: you row out, you shoot him until you drown, you file the paperwork, and you row out again. Every arrow counts. The damage stays. Gary remembers. And somewhere around your four hundredth drowning, you start to win.


MAN vs. GARY is an idle comedy boss-siege that plays whether you're watching or not — a hand-illustrated storybook world where failure is the whole point and the sea monster always dies mid-sentence.

  • Lose, professionally. Death isn't a fail state — it's a filing. Every drowning pays out, advances the story, and stamps another Maritime Incident Report. The monster's HP never resets; your worst day still chipped him.

  • Idle that respects your time. The crew keeps rowing, shooting, and drowning while you're away. Come home to progress, a report, and a monster that's had hours to think about it.

The harbour is the shop. Walk the quay, buy a better bow, a sturdier boat, a crew of sorts (a second guy, a motivational parrot, a man who writes things down) and a grudge that pays interest.

  • A roster of seven things that want you gone. Gary the kraken. Ignatius, who is on fire and knows it. The Deep Sea Lurker, who is so sorry. Kevin & Kevin, a two-headed argument.THE BARONESS, who owns the seabed and resents being involved. THE COMMITTEE, which cannot kill you without a motion. And — after the gym montage — SWOLE GARY.

The sun sets on every sea, the moon comes up, the lanterns go on, and the fight does not stop.

Nobody asked it to.

  • Retire the Captain. When the wall is too high, hang up the bow and hand the boat to someone angrier. He inherits the grudge, the statue and every way you have died — plus a permanent damage bonus that stacks with every retirement. Monsters that took you hours start dying in minutes. Retiring isn't starting over. It's a promotion, and there's a certificate.

  • THE DROWNING BOARD. A global leaderboard that ranks the entire world by how many times they have drowned. Aim high.

  • A game that talks back. Hundreds of lines of deadpan monster commentary, bureaucratic death reports, a Committee that produces one (1) actionable insight, a gentleman gull who would never, and a mandatory tea break observed by both sides.

Built by one person, with care

Every arrow, every drowning, every terrible pun is the work of a solo studio. No micro transactions, no energy timers, no nonsense — just you, a boat, and a kraken with a grievance.

The monster dies mid-sentence. That is a promise.

The free demo is available until November 20.

Limited-time playtests are planned afterward. Add Mana Boom to your wishlist to be notified when it launches.

When Magic Meets Physics, Things Get Messy!

Welcome to a witch academy where competition has gotten a little out of hand!

Mana Boom is a 2D pixel-art physics party game for up to 8 players online. Here, witches don't just blast each other with spells. They swing around on ropes, blow the ground out from under their rivals, and create new platforms when there's nowhere left to stand.

Whether you're battling or racing, the goal is simple: Win!

How you get there is entirely up to you.

Don't Like the Terrain? Change It!

In Mana Boom, the world doesn't stay the way you found it.

Blow through walls, dig holes beneath your enemies, or use magic to create new platforms wherever you need them.

Need a shortcut? Make one! About to fall? Build yourself a foothold! Someone chasing you? Maybe it's time to remove the ground beneath their feet.

Destroy, create, and turn the environment to your advantage.

Just remember, your rivals can use the things you build, too.

One Spell, Endless Possibilities!

Grab your wand, take aim, charge up, and fire!

Arcing spells might seem simple at first, but there's plenty of room for mischief. Make your shots split into multiple projectiles, bounce around, drill through terrain, rewind, shatter, or grow heavier. Mix and match these behaviors with different elemental effects to create your own magical combinations!

  • Fire: Set the terrain ablaze and watch the flames spread.

  • Water: Unleash a flood to wash your rivals away, or use the current to propel yourself.

  • Ice: Freeze your opponents solid, and leave the ground frozen for anyone who comes along later.

  • Lightning: Let electric shocks jump from the blast area to multiple nearby targets.

Still not enough? Swap places with another witch, trap rivals in spiderwebs, unleash homing magic, or leave behind a mysterious present that punches anyone who gets too close!

Magic isn't just about dealing damage. When to use it, how to combine it, and what else you can do with it is all up to your imagination.

Magic + Physics. What Could Possibly Go Wrong?

This is where things get really interesting.

Blast a hole in the ground, and a pool of water might come rushing through, sweeping away everyone below.

About to fall off a cliff? Quickly create a platform, fire your rope, and swing yourself back to safety.

Enemy hiding behind a wall? Dig a tunnel around them! Can't land a direct hit? Just blow up whatever they're standing on!

Use your rope to swing across the map, or hook another witch and drag them somewhere they'd rather not be. Explosions aren't just for attacking, either. Sometimes a good blast is exactly what you need to send yourself flying.

Magic, ropes, terrain, and physics all interact, turning even the simplest tools into something completely unexpected.

Sometimes you'll pull off a brilliant move you never planned.

Other times, one little mistake will set off a chain of disasters nobody can stop.

Either way, things are bound to get interesting!

Seven Game Modes, Seven Ways to Cause Trouble!

Fighting isn't everything! Race to the finish, steal flags, grab coins, or hop on a broom and take the chaos to the skies.

Deathmatch

Knock out as many rival witches as you can and rack up points. Fighting head-on works, but blowing up the ground beneath someone can be so much easier.

Rope Race

Swing through the course at high speed and find the fastest route to the finish. Someone getting ahead of you? Just hook them with your rope and pull them back!

Capture the Flag

Break into enemy territory and steal their flag! Charge through the front, snatch it with your rope, or dig a secret tunnel and sneak right in.

Broom Battle

Hop on your broom and battle it out in the skies! Flying skill matters, but so does knowing when to blast someone out of the air.

Broom Race

Speed through twists, turns, obstacles, and boost zones on your broom. And if another witch gets in your way, why not knock them straight into a magical barrier?

Coin Rush

Grab coins and watch your treasure chest grow! Just remember, the more valuable your chest becomes, the more everyone else wants a piece of it.

Jump Race

Charge your jumps and climb through tricky platforms and obstacles. Of course, getting to the top is easier when you knock your rivals into the sea!

Every mode has its own objective, but there's never just one way to win.

Lost This Round? Try Something Sneakier Next Time!

In multi-round tournaments, the game mode can change from one round to the next, and your magic keeps evolving along the way.

Choose upgrades between rounds to strengthen your spells, change how your projectiles behave, and experiment with new combinations of elements and magic.

Will you keep improving your favorite spell, or try a combination that sounds completely ridiculous?

You never know. That harmless little spell from the first round might become everyone else's worst nightmare after a few upgrades!

No Friends Around? The AI Witches Are Ready!

Play online with up to 8 players, or take on AI-controlled witches. Even when nobody else is around, you can still enjoy the different modes and tournaments on your own.

Customize your witch's appearance, or use the built-in Map Editor to create your own arenas for everyone to fight, race, and wreak havoc in.

Pull every dirty trick you can to win. Just be careful it doesn't backfire on you!

You're welcome to stream and upload videos of Mana Boom, including monetized ones. No permission needed.

Defend the flame. Shape your strategy. Survive the unknown.

Forge your mana dominion in a fast-paced rogue-like RTS where strategy, magic, and survival collide. At the heart of your settlement lies your campfire. If it falls, the run ends. Every decision, every unit, and every building must serve one purpose: keep the fire alive.

Build and expand your magical base in real time, gathering resources and training units from powerful schools of magic. Command forces aligned with Arcane, Fire, Frost, Light, and Dark... Each offering distinct playstyles, synergies, and tactical depth.

But raw power alone won’t be enough.

Deckbuilding Meets RTS

As you play, you’ll earn runes that form the foundation of your deck. During each run, draft and play cards to enhance your army by empowering units, enhancing abilities, and reshaping your strategy on the fly. No two runs play the same, and the right deck can mean the difference between survival and collapse.

A World of Escalating Threats

Explore a dynamic world divided into diverse biomes, each with unique enemies, bosses, and challenges:

Forest:  Overrun by relentless undead

Desert:  Controlled by brutal orc warlords

Frozen Mountains:  Defended by hardened dwarven forces

Ancient Ruins:  Guarded by mysterious elven remnants

As time passes, the pressure intensifies. Enemies grow stronger, attacks become bigger, and your defences are constantly tested.

Adapt. Evolve. Survive.

Level up your units in real time, unlock powerful upgrades, and evolve simple troops into devastating forces of war. Whether you focus on overwhelming offense, layered defences, or synergistic spell combinations, your strategy must adapt to survive.

Hold out long enough, and you’ll face a climactic boss encounter designed to push your build to its limits.

Progression That Carries Forward

Death is not the end. Between runs, unlock permanent upgrades that enhance your faction, expand your strategic options, and prepare you for the challenges ahead. With each attempt, you grow stronger and smarter.

Key Features

Rogue-like RTS gameplay with high replayability

Campfire survival core. Lose it, and the run ends

Deckbuilding system powered by runes earnt in game

More than 130 unique deck cards

Multiple magical schools with unique units and synergies

Real-time base building, resource gathering, and combat

Distinct biomes with themed enemies and challenges

Dynamic upgrades and evolving abilities every run

Persistent progression through a permanent card system

Intense end-of-run boss battles

Build fast. Defend smarter. Choose your cards carefully.

The swords are fake. The hits don't count. The monster is a guy in a costume.

Manala is a game about live-action roleplay (LARP). You build a combat deck, fight monsters or other players and take their stuff. The whole game works solo, and you can join other players whenever you like.

The swords are fake. Your first sword is PVC pipe, a pool noodle and silver tape. The tape is coming off. Later you can get a latex sword. It hits just as hard.

The hits don't count. About to get hit? Take it on the head. Headshots are not allowed, so it doesn't count. Still losing? Forget to count your health points. You will feel it after the fight.

The monster is a guy in a costume. The orcs are people in masks. The new guy is making instant noodles. Someone wants to check your wristband.

What you do

  • Play solo or with others: The whole game works solo. You can multibox and run a full party of your own characters. Or play with up to four friends.

  • Your gear decides your cards: The things you carry decide which cards you can play. Left your shield at camp? No blocking. All cards are open from the start. Your gear is your strategy.

  • Five classes: Warrior, mage, healer, alchemist and smith.

  • Light vs. Darkness: Pick a side and take regions from the enemy. At the end of each season, the Frog of the North names the winner.

  • Full-loot PvP: Kill someone and take their stuff. It's a PVC sword, but it's still worth something.

  • A big world: Over 1,200 rooms in 20+ areas. Forests, marshes and forts from Finno-Ugric folklore. Do quests and craft your own gear.

Real LARPers

Every player character is a photo of a real Estonian LARPer. Their own costume, their own foam sword, their own plywood shield. Like fighting games in the early 90s.

Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, one of the oldest board games in the world. The rules are simple: pick one of your pits, scoop up its marbles and drop them one by one into the pits that follow. Drop the last one in your store and you go again. Drop it in an empty pit of yours and you capture the pit across from it.

Then the marbles get powers. Fire burns marbles on the other side of the board, Multiply doubles a whole pit, a Black Hole swallows the pits beside it. Plan a move so they go off together, chain your extra turns, and one move can score millions.

Each run is a climb through 8 tables. Every match has a score target: each point you score drains it, and emptying it wins the match. Between matches, spend your winnings in The Bazaar on new marbles and Blessings that bend the rules. Each table ends with a boss that changes how the game plays. Lose a match and the run ends with new unlocks: start again with a new pouch, a new shop and everything you’ve learned as you aim to become the true Mancalero!

Build your pouch of special marbles — each with its own effect when sown. Lightning chains. Fire burns enemy marbles. Glass scales points rapidly, then shatters. The deeper you go, the stranger your collection gets.

There are two ways to win a match: drain your opponent’s Score Target to zero, or have more marbles in your Mancala storehouse when one side of the board runs out.

Spend your winnings in the Bazaar on new marbles, powerful Blessings, and Embroidery patches that bend the rules in your favour.

 

Each table ends with a Boss that changes how the game is played — not always just a harder fight, but a different one. Learn them or lose to them. If you win, you may still receive a curse!

The right marble synergies can produce scores that were never supposed to exist. Find the combos. Push the multipliers. See how high the numbers go!

GAME CONTENTS

  • 8 full Tables — each with 2 matches and a boss encounter

  • 15+ marble types, including Glass, Lightning, Multiply, Thief, Boomerang, Black Hole and more

  • 15+ Blessings to collect

  • Set Bonuses — hidden synergies between your Blessings and marbles

  • Embroidery Patches — shop upgrades that modify prices, slots and scoring

  • Endless Mode — unlocked after clearing Table 8

  • Different pouches to start your run with, each changing your starting marbles and upgrades — some must be unlocked first!

 STARTING TIPS

  • Your Mancala storehouse is the large pit on the right — landing your last marble there earns a free extra turn.

  • Combos multiply your score. Landing specials (Multiply, Gold, Lightning) back-to-back is stronger than spreading them out.

  • Pay attention to how your opponent plays: mistakes and habits can be exploited and punished.

  • The Beginner’s Pouch starts you with two Embroidery Patches already equipped — a strong choice to push for Endless once it’s unlocked.

  • Check the Compendium to track what you’ve discovered and learn how each marble type works.

 FAQ

Is progress saved between runs? Unlocks (such as new Pouch types) persist across runs. Score history is also saved locally.

What is Endless Mode? After clearing Table 8, you continue facing versions of previous enemies and bosses with progressive scaling. 

Is there controller or mobile support? Yes! The game runs on Mouse and Keyboard and also has support for controllers. SteamDeck support and verification are on the docket.
